title: Out of Scope Modification-Adding additional repair work to existing order
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP WEAPON SYSTEMS SUPPORT.NAVSUP WSS MECHANICSBURG.NAVSUP WEAPON SYSTEMS SUPPORT MECH
detail_text: Please note that this is not a request for proposal nor a request for quote as there is no solicitation document available. This is a notice of intent to add additional testing work to the existing repair contract for a qty. 1 7B Battery. (NIIN 017190695) to sole source vendor. Information received in response to this special notice will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. The determination to not compete the proposed acqusition is wholly within the discretion of the Govenment. The North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS) is 335911. Responses to this notice are due to Leigh Catchings by email-leigh.e.catchings.civ@us.navy.mil.
